text: Yedduɓe Alla ɓen wi'i: "Men gomɗintaa ndee Alxur'aanaare nde Muhammadu aaƴii wonnde ko jippinaande e makko, men gomɗintaa kadi Defte jippinooɗe ɗen ado mayre. Sinno a tinayno an Nulaaɗo, tuma nde tooñuɓe ɓen haɓɓaa ka Joomi maɓɓe Ñalnde Darngal fii hasbeede, hara haala kan no yiltindiree hakkunde maɓɓe, woɗɓe e maɓɓe bugo feloore nde e ɓeya. Waawanooɓe lo'inanooɓe ɓen wi'ana hooreeɓe maɓɓe lo'inunooɓe ɓen aduna: Si wanaano fii on majjinii men, men gomɗinayno Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on.
